en.headline: Private home prices edge up 0.06 percent in August
en.dek: The Rating and Valuation Department’s overall price index rose to 320.5, while the rental index climbed 1.64 percent to a record 210.3.
body: Hong Kong private residential prices rose slightly in August, according to provisional figures released on Monday by the Rating and Valuation Department. The overall price index stood at 320.5, up 0.06 percent from July and 10.98 percent higher than a year earlier.

Prices of small and medium-sized flats below 100 square metres were unchanged on the month. Larger units of 100 square metres or more rose 0.42 percent. Over the first eight months of 2026 the overall price index was up 6.98 percent.

The August reading remained about 19.5 percent below the September 2021 peak of 398.1. Class A and B flats were flat month on month, while Class C units rose 0.16 percent and the two largest size bands rose 0.42 percent and 0.46 percent.

Rents continued to climb. The private residential rental index rose 1.64 percent to 210.3, a record high and the tenth consecutive monthly increase. Rents were 5.26 percent higher than a year earlier and 4.89 percent higher over the first eight months of the year.

zh.headline: 8月私宅售價指數微升0.06% 租金指數再創新高
zh.dek: 差餘物業估價署公布8月整體售價指數報320.5，按年升10.98%；租金指數升1.64%至210.3，連升10個月。
body: 差餘物業估價署周一公布的臨時數據顯示，2026年8月全港私人住宅售價指數報320.5，按月微升0.06%，按年升10.98%。
實用面積100平方米以下的中小型單位按月持平，100平方米或以上較大單位則升0.42%。今年首8個月整體售價指數累升6.98%。
8月指數仍較2021年9月歷史高位398.1低約19.5%。分類計，A類及B類單位按月持平，C類升0.16%，D類及E類分別升0.42%及0.46%。
租金方面，私人住宅租金指數升至210.3，按月升1.64%，再創有紀錄新高，並連升10個月。租金按年升5.26%，今年首8個月累升4.89%。
